name: Hypnotized By My Assassin
source:
Play again as Robert Liebart, a man on the run after a failed casino heist that almost cost him his life.

The powers-that-be want you gone, and they have hired the perfect assassin for the job : the intriguing and hypnotic Veronica Monforte. The sun is setting down on the tropical resort as the seductive woman takes her time, letting the trap she laid slowly close on you. Veronica boldly claims she is here to assassinate you, so why are you inexplicably attracted to her?

[Edited from [url=https://peachpunchgames.itch.io/hypnotized-by-my-assassin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
再次扮演罗伯特·利巴特，一名在一次失败的赌场抢劫中几乎丧命的逃亡者。

当权者希望你离开，他们已经聘请了完美的刺客来完成这项工作：迷人且催眠的维罗妮卡·蒙福特。太阳正在热带度假村落下，迷人的女人慢慢地让她布下的陷阱慢慢靠近你。维罗妮卡大胆声称她是来刺杀你的，那你为什么会莫名地被她吸引呢？

[编辑自[url=https://peachpunchgames.itch.io/hypnotized-by-my-assassin]itch.io[/url]]
